newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air CAT ups turnover and traffic.
newsitem.headline: Air CAT ups turnover and traffic.

text.p: Air CAT, air freight subsidiary of French forwarder, Compagnie d'Affretement et de Transport (CAT), tabled a 1996 turnover of 138.8 million francs ($24.3 million) compared to 127.8 millon francs the previous year, a CAT spokesman for CAT which is part of the Renault car group told Reuters.
Air CAT, which has its headquarters at Paris/CDG, handled a combined total of 7,486 tonnes of import and export traffic in 1996, compared to 7,481 tonnes in 1995, the spokesman said.

"Export traffic totalled 5,544 tonnes, an increase of eight percent on 1995, with the Far East and Latin America showing the strongest growth while import traffic fell by 17.3 percent to 1,942 tonnes."

CAT tabled a global turnover of 5.14 billion francs, up 10.7 percent on 1995 generating net profits of 165.4 million francs up 31.5 percent on 1995, the spokesman added. - - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 ($ = 5.712 French Francs)
